notes.title: Rework the project.
notes.content:
Dear Players.

   First and foremost, I want to sincerely thank all of you for your support and interest in my project, Arsilon. I started developing this game with great hopes, but unfortunately, the project did not live up to expectations. I understand that many of you were looking forward to something different, and I deeply regret that I was unable to meet your expectations.
After much consideration, I have decided to completely rework the project. As a result:
[olist]
[*] A full refund will be issued to all players who purchased the current version of the game.
[*] The project will undergo significant changes, including a new title, genre, and overall direction.
[*] The Steam store page will be updated to reflect the new concept and details of the upcoming project.
[/olist]
   I understand that this project holds meaning for many of you, and I don’t want it to be forgotten. As a tribute to Arsilon, I will include special artwork from the original version in the new game — a token of my gratitude for your support and interest.
   Thank you from the bottom of my heart to everyone who has been part of this journey. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment or reach out to support.

Sincerely,
ArtTrace
shiwadan@gmail.com

Added an effect when hit by a blaster.

notes.title: Arsilon Update Alpha 4
notes.content:
Added shooting. The suit became equipped with a built-in blaster.
Added enemies.
Added loot from enemies - energy elements and a run accelerator.
The external and internal appearance of the hero's spaceship has been updated.
Added functionality and animations to the spaceship.
Added interaction with air temperature. The weather now affects the character's health.
Added significant first-person camera zoom.
Added more detailed information about the state of the character in the first person mode (time, number of kills, maximum health, energy, etc.)
Created a menu for the graphic settings of the game.
Help menu created.

notes.title: Arsilon Update to Alpha 4.0
notes.content:
List of changes:
1. Added shooting with low time to kill (2-3 hits). The suit became equipped with a built-in blaster.
2. Added enemies with reactions on hit.
3. Added loot from enemies - energy elements and a run accelerator.
4. The external and internal appearance of the hero's spaceship has been updated.
5. Added functionality and animations to the spaceship.
6. Added interaction with air temperature. The weather now affects the character's health.

8. Added more detailed information about the state of the character in the first person mode (time, number of kills, maximum health, energy, etc.)
9. Created a menu for the graphic settings of the game.
10. Help menu created.
